title: Tournaments timeline strip
subject: History
unit: Spring 1: The history of sports tournaments (Mighty Metals)
source: Seeded from history/y3 lesson 5 (Tournaments timeline strip (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 5: What is a tournament?. To understand what a tournament is and place famous tournaments on a timeline

timeline.label: 776 BC
timeline.text: First recorded ancient Olympic Games, Greece

questions.q: Order: 1930 World Cup, 776 BC Olympics, 1896 Olympics.
questions.model: BC dates come first. 776 BC is first. Then the smaller AD date: 1896. Then 1930.

questions.q: Is a single friendly match a tournament?
questions.a: No: a tournament has many matches and one overall winner

questions.q: In which country was the first football World Cup?
Core: Make a tournaments timeline with four events and dates.
questions.a: 776 BC ancient Olympics; 1100s jousting tournaments; 1896 modern Olympics; 1930 World Cup
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: draw a long line, mark year 1 in the middle, write 776 BC on the left.

questions.q: Extend: Add today's date and one tournament happening now.
questions.a: For example: a current football league or cup

questions.q: Stretch: How many years between the first modern Olympics and the first World Cup?

questions.a: Many matches and one overall winner
options: Many matches and one overall winner

questions.q: Big question: why have people always loved competing?
questions.a: For example: to test strength and skill, to have fun together and to win prizes
